name: Dire Wolf
description: A large wolf with menacing teeth, seldom encountered alone.

abilities.name: Pack Tactics
abilities.description: If the Wolf makes a successful standard attack and another Dire Wolf is within Melee range of the target, deal 1d6+5 physical damage instead of their standard damage and you gain a Fear.

abilities.name: Hobbling Strike
abilities.description: Mark a Stress to make an attack against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 3d4+10 direct physical damage and make them Vulnerable until they clear at least 1 HP.
